item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 12/Feb/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will bring generally fine weather to southern China in the next couple of days. With the monsoon moderating, it will be relatively humid and misty over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week. Under the influence of a maritime airstream, it will be warm and humid over the coastal areas of Guangdong early next week.
